text: **Big finding (systemic, HIGH priority):** writes are silently failing to publish for some event kinds while the app *lies about success*. Concretely — unfollow (kind:3, #69) and profile-edit (kind:0) update the UI and the Outbox says "All published," but the relay is never updated; and B4's repost (kind:6) count never updated. Regular kind:1 notes/replies *do* publish. So it's replaceable/other kinds failing silently + a false-success Outbox. I flagged the full scope on #69. This is exactly the "we are not just accepting broken things / data integrity" class you wanted caught.
